chapters.title: Lehi's Vision of the Coming Destruction
chapters.synopsis: Nephi opens his record by introducing his family and his father Lehi, a prophet in Jerusalem. Lehi sees a pillar of fire and a vision of God on His throne, then reads from a heavenly book that foretells Jerusalem's destruction. When he prophesies to the people, they mock him and seek his life.

segments.note: Nephi introduces himself and his record

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi recounts Lehi's visions and rejection

chapters.title: Lehi Leads His Family into the Wilderness
chapters.synopsis: Commanded by the Lord in a dream, Lehi abandons his home and riches and leads his family into the wilderness near the Red Sea. Laman and Lemuel murmur against their father, but Nephi seeks the Lord and his heart is softened. The Lord promises Nephi that he will be made a ruler and teacher over his brethren.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: The family departs; Laman and Lemuel murmur

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Lord promises Nephi rulership and prosperity

chapters.title: The Errand for the Brass Plates
chapters.synopsis: The Lord commands Lehi to send his sons back to Jerusalem for the brass plates held by Laban. Laban refuses them twice, steals their property, and sends servants to kill them. As Laman and Lemuel beat their younger brothers, an angel appears and promises that the Lord will deliver Laban into their hands.

segments.note: Nephi returns to his father's tent

segments.speaker: lehi1

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Two failed attempts; an angel intervenes

chapters.title: Nephi Obtains the Brass Plates
chapters.synopsis: Nephi creeps into Jerusalem by night, led by the Spirit without knowing beforehand what he should do. He finds Laban drunk in the street and, after the Spirit constrains him, slays Laban and takes his armor and sword. Disguised as Laban, he obtains the plates and persuades Laban's servant Zoram to join the family in the wilderness.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi rallies his brothers with Moses' example

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Laban slain; the plates and Zoram obtained

chapters.title: Sariah Comforted; Lehi Searches the Plates
chapters.synopsis: Sariah, fearing her sons have perished, complains against Lehi until they return safely and her faith is confirmed. Lehi searches the brass plates and finds the five books of Moses, a record of the Jews, prophecies, and his own genealogy back to Joseph of Egypt. He prophesies that the plates will go to his posterity and never perish.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: The sons return; Lehi searches the plates

chapters.title: The Purpose of Nephi's Record
chapters.synopsis: Nephi pauses to explain why he writes. He will not record his father's genealogy or the ordinary history of his people, for that belongs on other plates. His whole intent is to persuade all to come unto the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob and be saved.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi states the aim of his writing

chapters.title: The Return for Ishmael's Family
chapters.synopsis: The sons of Lehi return to Jerusalem once more and persuade Ishmael and his household to join them, so the family can raise up seed in the promised land. On the journey Laman, Lemuel, and part of Ishmael's family rebel, bind Nephi, and plan to leave him to die. Nephi is freed by the power of God, and after pleading by Ishmael's family the rebels repent.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Ishmael's family joins; rebellion begins

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi rebukes his rebellious brothers

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi bound, freed, and the rebels repent

chapters.title: Lehi's Dream of the Tree of Life
chapters.synopsis: Lehi tells his family of a dream in which he tasted the fruit of a tree whose sweetness filled his soul with joy. He sees a rod of iron along a strait and narrow path, mists of darkness, a river of filthy water, and a great and spacious building filled with mocking crowds. Sariah, Sam, and Nephi come to the tree, but Laman and Lemuel refuse, and Lehi exhorts them with all a father's feeling.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi sets the scene in the wilderness

segments.speaker: lehi1
segments.note: Lehi recounts the tree of life dream

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Lehi exhorts Laman and Lemuel

chapters.title: Two Sets of Plates for Wise Purposes
chapters.synopsis: Nephi explains that he keeps two records: large plates for the history of his people and these small plates for the ministry and sacred things. He does not know why the Lord commands the second record, but the Lord knows all things and prepares for His purposes. It matters not to Nephi, for the commandment is enough.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi explains the two sets of plates

chapters.title: Lehi Prophesies of the Messiah
chapters.synopsis: Nephi records his father's prophecies: Jerusalem will be destroyed, the Jews carried captive to Babylon and later returned, and six hundred years after Lehi's departure a Messiah and Redeemer will come. Lehi tells of the prophet who will baptize Him and compares scattered Israel to an olive tree whose branches will be grafted in again. Nephi then declares that the mysteries of God are unfolded to all who diligently seek, for God is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi summarizes Lehi's Messianic prophecies

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi teaches that revelation is for all

chapters.title: Nephi Sees the Condescension of God
chapters.synopsis: Desiring to know the things his father saw, Nephi is caught away by the Spirit to a high mountain. He sees the tree of life, the virgin of Nazareth, and the Son of God born into the world. An angel then shows him the Redeemer's baptism, ministry, and crucifixion, and interprets the tree as the love of God.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi is caught away to a mountain

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: The Spirit questions and blesses Nephi

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: An angel shows Christ's birth and ministry

chapters.title: The Promised Land in Vision
chapters.synopsis: The angel shows Nephi his descendants in the promised land: their wars, the destructions at the crucifixion, and the risen Christ ministering to them. Nephi sees three generations of righteousness followed by pride and unbelief. His seed is finally overcome by the seed of his brethren, who dwindle in darkness.

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: The rise and fall of Nephi's seed

chapters.title: The Gentiles, the Bible, and the Restoration
chapters.synopsis: Nephi sees the formation of a great and abominable church and the discovery and colonizing of the promised land by the Gentiles. He watches a book, the record of the Jews, go forth to the Gentiles after plain and precious truths have been taken from it. The Lord promises to bring forth other records to restore those truths and to be merciful to the Gentiles who repent.

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: Gentile nations, the Bible, and restored records

chapters.title: Two Churches and the Covenants of God
chapters.synopsis: The angel declares that there are save two churches only: the church of the Lamb of God and the church of the devil. Nephi sees the saints of God, few in number, armed with righteousness and power, while the wrath of God falls on the great and abominable church. He is shown the apostle John, who will write the remainder of these things.

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: The two churches and the last days

chapters.title: Nephi Explains His Father's Vision
chapters.synopsis: Returning to the tent, Nephi finds his brothers disputing about Lehi's words and asks whether they have inquired of the Lord. He explains the olive tree, the scattering and gathering of Israel, the rod of iron as the word of God, and the river as the awful gulf separating the wicked from the tree of life. He teaches that the final judgment will divide the righteous from the wicked forever.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi finds his brothers disputing

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi interprets the dream and the olive tree

chapters.title: The Liahona and the Broken Bow
chapters.synopsis: The sons of Lehi marry the daughters of Ishmael, and the Lord provides the Liahona, a ball of curious workmanship that points the way according to their faith. When Nephi's steel bow breaks and the family goes hungry, even Lehi murmurs, but Nephi makes a new bow and humbly asks his father where to hunt. Ishmael dies at Nahom, and the Lord chastens the murmurers.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Marriages, the Liahona, hunger, and Nahom

chapters.title: Commanded to Build a Ship
chapters.synopsis: After eight years in the wilderness the family reaches Bountiful by the sea, and the Lord commands Nephi to build a ship. His brothers mock him, so Nephi recounts how the Lord led Israel out of Egypt and rebukes them for their hardness of heart. Filled with the power of God, he confounds them, and the Lord commands them to help build the ship.

segments.note: Arrival at Bountiful; the command to build

segments.note: The brothers mock and complain

chapters.title: The Voyage to the Promised Land
chapters.synopsis: Nephi finishes the ship after the manner the Lord shows him, and the family sets sail with provisions and seeds. When Laman, Lemuel, and others revel rudely, they bind Nephi, and the Liahona ceases to work as a terrible storm drives the ship back. After four days they repent and free Nephi, the storm calms, and the family arrives safely in the promised land.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: The ship, the storm, and the safe arrival

chapters.title: Plates of Ore and Prophecies of Christ
chapters.synopsis: In the promised land Nephi makes plates of ore and records his people's history, then explains the sacred purpose of these smaller plates. Quoting Zenock, Neum, and Zenos, he prophesies that the God of Israel will be crucified and buried, and that Israel will be scattered and gathered again. He reads the words of Isaiah to his people so they may liken the scriptures unto themselves.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi makes plates and explains their purpose

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi cites Zenos, Zenock, and Neum on Christ

chapters.title: Hearken, O House of Jacob
chapters.synopsis: Nephi quotes Isaiah's words to covenant Israel, who swear by the Lord's name but not in righteousness. The Lord declares He has refined Israel in the furnace of affliction and foretold events from the beginning so no idol could claim them. He calls Israel out of Babylon, declaring there is no peace for the wicked.

segments.speaker: isaiah
segments.note: Isaiah 48: Israel refined in affliction

chapters.title: A Light to the Gentiles
chapters.synopsis: Isaiah speaks as the servant called from the womb to restore Israel and be a light to the Gentiles. Though Zion says the Lord has forsaken her, He answers that He cannot forget her, for she is graven upon the palms of His hands. Kings and queens will become nursing fathers and mothers as the Lord gathers His scattered children.

segments.speaker: isaiah
segments.note: Isaiah 49: Zion is never forgotten

chapters.title: Nephi Interprets Isaiah's Prophecies
chapters.synopsis: Nephi's brothers ask whether Isaiah's words are temporal or spiritual, and he explains that Israel will be scattered among all nations. A mighty Gentile nation will arise in the promised land, and the Lord will do a marvelous work to gather His covenant people. The righteous need not fear, for the wicked will be destroyed and the Holy One will reign in righteousness.

segments.speaker: nephi1
segments.note: Nephi interprets Isaiah for his brothers
